items.title: Justin Jefferson 1-yard TD gives Vikings 7-3 lead over Lions
items.text: Justin Jefferson has made it to the end zone.

items.title: DJ Wonnum carted off after friendly fire collision with Brian Branch
items.text: Two Lions collided late in the second quarter and both had to be taken off the field.

items.title: Vikings lead Lions 7-6 at halftime
items.text: It's been a heavyweight battle between NFC North foes in Detroit through 30 minutes, with the Vikings clinging to a 7-6 lead at halftime.

items.title: DJ Wonnum, Brian Branch both ruled out with a concussion
items.text: The Lions will have to play the rest of Sunday's game against the Vikings without two key defenders.

items.title: Lions take 12-7 lead with Jahmyr Gibbs 30-yard touchdown run
items.text: The Lions have taken a second-half lead over the Vikings.

items.title: Lions LB Jack Campbell carted off on a backboard early in fourth quarter
items.text: There is a concerning injury situation developing in Detroit.

items.title: Kyler Murray puts Vikings up 15-12 over Lions in fourth quarter
items.text: Kyler Murray's day hadn't been going particularly well in Detroit.

items.title: Lions hand Vikings first loss of the season, Detroit wins 19-15
items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs rushed for 153 yards, including a 30-yard touchdown, to help Detroit improve to 5-2.

items.title: Rams dominate second half, defeat Chargers 24-9
items.text: The Rams scored 21 unanswered points to beat the Chargers, sending the cross-town team to 0-7 in 2026.

items.title: Dan Campbell had "no new information" on Jack Campbell after Sunday's win
items.text: Lions linebacker Jack Campbell was carted off the field while on a backboard during Sunday's win over the Vikings and there's no immediate word on his condition.

items.title: Tom Brady drops another "s" bomb live on Fox
items.text: We may never know whether the NFL fined Raiders minority owner/Fox broadcaster Tom Brady for openly and repeatedly criticizing officials during last Sunday's Packers-Lions game.

items.title: Raiders up 7-3 after Brock Bowers TD
items.text: The Jets couldn't punch the ball into the end zone on their first drive of Sunday's game against the Raiders, but their visitors from Las Vegas had more success.

items.title: Raiders score NFL's first kickoff return touchdown of 2026
items.text: The Jets moved back into the lead on a second quarter touchdown, but their edge over the Raiders did not last long.

items.title: Geno Smith throws two touchdowns, Jets lead Raiders 23-14 at halftime
items.text: The Jets had the ball five times in the first half of Sunday's game against the Raiders and they picked up points on all five possessions.

items.title: Raiders take 35-30 lead early in fourth quarter
items.text: Defense has been lacking for both teams at MetLife Stadium and the Raiders have taken advantage of the Jets' shortcomings to move back into the lead.

items.title: Raiders end losing streak with 38-33 win over Jets
items.text: Kirk Cousins threw three touchdowns to get the Raiders to 4-4 on the year.

items.title: Browns go for first sweep of Steelers since 1988
items.text: When the Browns visit the Steelers today, first place in the AFC North is on the line between the pair of 5-2 teams.

items.title: Patrick Mahomes' third TD gives Chiefs a 24-13 lead
items.text: The Chiefs have opened it up against the Broncos, taking a 24-13 lead late in the third quarter.

items.title: After Deshaun Watson fumble, Rico Dowdle TD gives Steelers 7-0 lead
items.text: The Browns have had two offensive possessions and lost a fumble on both of them.

items.title: Steelers rush for 160 yards in first half, lead Browns 20-6
items.text: The Steelers are running all over the Browns and have a 20–6 lead at halftime.

items.title: Jaylen Warren rushes for 143 on his birthday, Steelers beat Browns 27-6
items.text: The streak continues for the Steelers and Browns in Pittsburgh.

items.title: Jaquan Brisker on Jared Verse: He should have kept his mouth shut
items.text: Browns defensive end Jared Verse talked the talk, but he didn't back it up, and the Steelers let him know both on the field and in their postgame comments.

items.title: Falcons rule out four players, elevate two
items.text: The Falcons ruled out cornerback Billy Bowman Jr.

items.title: Buccaneers lead 9-0 as Baker Mayfield has 0 completions, Michael Penix has 3 interceptions
items.text: On a rainy, windy, sloppy day in Tampa, the Buccaneers have taken a two-possession lead without completing a pass.

items.title: Buccaneers don't complete a pass, beat Falcons 16-0 anyway
items.text: In one of the most shocking box scores you'll ever see, the Bucs won without completing a pass in rainy Tampa Bay.

items.title: Jonathan Taylor is active for the Colts on Sunday
items.text: Running back Jonathan Taylor may not be a member of the Colts at this time next week, but he will be in their lineup in Jacksonville on Sunday.

items.title: Brian Thomas puts Jaguars up 7-0 over Colts
items.text: Jaguars head coach Liam Coen said he had confidence that wide receiver Brian Thomas would help the team make plays against the Colts in Week 8 and he was proven right in the first quarter.

items.title: DT DaVon Hamilton carted off, Jags lead 14-0
items.text: The Jaguars defense picked up the first turnover of Sunday's game against the Colts, but they lost a key member of the unit on the same play.

items.title: Jaguars stretch halftime lead to 28-0 on Daniel Jones pick-six
items.text: Anyone thinking the Colts would summon a Herculean effort in the wake of this week's white flag trades has been sorely disappointed by the first 30 minutes of play in Jacksonville.

items.title: Colts turn to Anthony Richardson with Jags up 42-7 in fourth quarter
items.text: The Colts have made a quarterback change.
